question: What will be the percentage change in the euro to US dollar exchange rate (EURUSD=X on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-05 to the close on 2026-08-13?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-08-13 / close on 2026-08-05 - 1), using daily closes of EURUSD=X on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-08-13, the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't get the official Aug 5 Yahoo close, but other sources put EUR/USD at about 1.154 that day, after a roughly 1% rise from about 1.142 on July 29. Nothing settles the question yet: the main movers before resolution are the US jobs report on Aug 7, news on the Strait of Hormuz and oil, and likely US inflation data around Aug 12.

## 1. Resolution source
- I couldn't load Yahoo Finance (EURUSD=X history): the proxy refused the connection. Two other history sites (poundsterlinglive and exchangerates.org.uk) were also refused, so I have not confirmed the official Aug 5 close.
- 2026-08-05: The ECB reference rate (set around 14:15 CET, not the Yahoo close) was 1.1554 USD per euro, published in the EU Official Journal on Aug 6. [EUR-Lex](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=OJ%3AC_202604082)
- 2026-08-05: A search snippet from Poundsterling Live shows a range of about 1.1527 to 1.1559 and a mid rate near 1.1543. I couldn't see the column labels. [Poundsterling Live](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/history/EUR-USD-2026)
- So the Aug 5 base close is probably about 1.153 to 1.155. Yahoo's close is the rate at about 23:00 London time.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened that settles the question. The window runs 6 trading days, from the Aug 5 close to the Aug 13 close.
- 2026-08-06: The euro reportedly slipped against the dollar for a second straight day after hitting a seven-week high. Uncertainty over a possible Iran deal was cited. [Economies.com](https://www.economies.com/commodities/oil-news/oil-prices-fall-as-investors-await-potential-strait-of-hormuz-deal-49448)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-06: Oil rose after Iranian state media published a draft plan with restrictive conditions for ships in the Strait of Hormuz. Brent closed up 3.8% at $82.49. Iran and Oman were reportedly working on transit-route rules. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/06/oil-price-iran-war-strait-hormuz-oman-deal.html)
- 2026-08-05: RoboForex put EUR/USD near 1.1536, with resistance at 1.1559 and support at 1.1519. It tied the euro's gains to reports of a possible US-Iran deal to reopen Hormuz, which pushed oil lower. It cited an ECB rate of 2.40% and a Fed rate of 3.75%. [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/currencies/eur-usd-forecast-2026-08-05/)
- 2026-08-04: RoboForex said the pair was testing about 1.1500, with a range of 1.1487 to 1.1570. It linked dollar weakness to shifting Fed expectations. [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/currencies/eur-usd-forecast-2026-08-04/)
- 2026-08-04: An RBC Capital Markets report kept a bullish dollar view, with a long-run EUR/USD target of 1.10. It flagged the Fed's damaged credibility after the July 29 press conference as a downside risk for the dollar. [RBC CM](https://www.rbccm.com/assets/rbccm/docs/fx/currency-report-card.pdf)
- 2026-07-29: The Fed held rates on a 9-3 vote; Hammack, Kashkari and Logan wanted a 25bp hike. EUR/USD rose above 1.1420, and was near 1.1450 during Chair Warsh's Q&A. [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/euro-rises-despite-fed-hawkish-hold-eyes-on-warshs-speech-202607291814), [XTB](https://www.xtb.com/ae-en/market-analysis/news-and-research/not-so-hawkish-words-dovish-dodges-eurusd-at-1-1450-during-kevin-warsh-s-q-a)
- Background: A search summary says the ECB raised its deposit rate 25bp in June 2026, its first hike since 2023. [StoneX](https://www.stonex.com/en-gb/news-and-analysis/eur-usd-q4-2026-outlook-euro-at-a-crossroads-as-fed-ecb-tighten/)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026 range: high 1.2081 on Jan 27, low 1.1325 on June 24, according to a search summary; the pair was about 1.138 in mid-July. [Octagon/Kalshi mirror](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/topics/eurusd-weekly/)
- Trend: up about 1% from about 1.142 (July 29) to about 1.154 (Aug 5), a seven-week high, then a small pullback on Aug 6.
- Typical variation (my own estimate, not from a source): EUR/USD implied volatility is usually about 6 to 9% a year. Over 6 trading days that is about 0.9 to 1.2% for one standard deviation. Moves beyond ±2% in a week are rare and usually need a big shock. The question's range (-3.5 to +2.5) covers well beyond normal moves.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi lists EUR/USD contracts (filed with the CFTC on July 16, 2026) and 15-minute markets. I couldn't find prices for an Aug 13 contract. [CFTC filing](https://www.cftc.gov/filings/ptc/ptc07162610487.pdf)
- Robinhood had daily EUR/USD markets for Aug 4 and Aug 5 (an "above 1.11" strike on Aug 5); I couldn't see any prices. [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/fx/events/euro-to-us-dollar-exchange-rate-august-5-2026-aug-05-2026/)
- I found nothing on Polymarket or Manifold.
- Analyst views are split: RBC leans toward a stronger dollar (1.10 long run), while RoboForex's short-term notes lean modestly toward a stronger euro.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-07 (Fri): US July jobs report. Consensus was about +80K, and Deutsche Bank expected +65K, versus June's +57K. [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/euro-flatlines-amid-mixed-german-data-with-all-eyes-on-us-nonfarm-payrolls-data-202608070630)
- Around 2026-08-12: US July inflation (CPI), likely in the window. I haven't confirmed the date against the BLS schedule. With the Fed split on a hike, a hot or cold reading could move the dollar a lot.
- Ongoing: US-Iran and Iran-Oman talks on the Strait of Hormuz. A deal that lowers oil has supported the euro, while setbacks have helped the dollar. This is the main headline risk.
- ECB: no meeting in the window; it is on its August break.
- Mid-August liquidity is usually thin, which can make sudden moves bigger.
